key_facts: DoD announced framework agreements with Northrop Grumman and Lockheed Martin to expand production of Patriot and THAAD interceptor components.
The initiative aims to triple production capacity for PAC-3 Missile Segment Enhancement interceptors and quadruple THAAD interceptor production capacity.
DoD's long-term procurement objective is nearly 14,000 Patriot and THAAD interceptors.
A CSIS analysis estimated the U.S. had depleted roughly two-thirds of its pre-war Patriot interceptor inventory during the conflict with Iran.
The agreements establish a second source for Patriot solid rocket motors and expand production of ignition safety devices and THAAD structural components.
